---
title: "Scope and learning goals"
---

This proposed course retains the scope of the documented 5MO101 predecessor.
It is not an approved syllabus for its 2027 successor, 5MO00S.

## Course components

| Component | Baseline credits |
| --- | ---: |
| Animal theory and group work | 6 ECTS |
| Animal practical work | 1.5 ECTS |
| Plant theory | 5 ECTS |
| Plant practical work | 2.5 ECTS |

## Learning goals

- Explain animal structure, function, regulation and environmental adaptation.
- Recognise representative normal tissues and relate their features to function.
- Explain plant organisation, metabolism, growth, development and regulation.
- Discuss applications, benefits, risks and ethics of genetically modified plants.
- Perform and interpret experiments and write scientific laboratory reports.
- Evaluate relevant literature and communicate orally and in writing.

## How the course works

Lectures and discussion connect mechanisms to observations. Anatomy, histology
and physiological experiments develop practical understanding. Reports,
literature work and presentations develop scientific communication.

The predecessor assesses theory through written examinations and practical and
communication skills through reports and oral presentation. The actual course
schedule, compulsory elements and assessment rules will be supplied once
verified. See [reading and sources](references.qmd).
